# Quarterly sales review

The sales team met on Monday to review the third quarter.
Revenue grew in every region except the north.

## Results by region

| Region | Revenue | Growth |
|---|---|---|
| Da Nang | 1,200 | 8% |
| Hanoi | 2,450 | 5% |
| Ho Chi Minh City | 3,100 | 11% |

## Decisions

1. Open a second office in Da Nang.
2. Hire two sales staff before December.
3. Review prices in the north.

### Follow-up

- Send the summary to every branch
  - Include the regional table
  - Attach last quarter's figures
- Book the next meeting
